Glided past me on the Barrier Beach Trail. It was coming up the trail toward me, about 200 yards in from Laudholm Beach, where the trail is on a dike through the marsh. It was "huge" and yellow, seen at arm's length and waist level as it cruised swiftly and directly past. I made a brief chase but it was gone in seconds. The dorsal field of medium yellow appeared unbroken and the butterfly seemed easily twice the size of the sulphurs I had seen earlier.
